verdict.rationale: Pulley documents vesting operations: it can record vesting acceleration, stop vesting when a stakeholder is terminated, and send email alerts whenever a holder reaches a vesting event, which implies it tracks vesting events. The evidence never shows ops users defining custom schedules with cliffs or milestones, nor an explicit vested-vs-unvested view, and acceleration appears as a manual adjustment rather than a configured exit trigger. Missing for 10: documented custom vesting schedule builder, cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, acceleration-on-exit triggers (single/double trigger), explicit vested vs unvested tracking views, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically

citations.quote: You wish to reflect an acceleration of vesting in Pulley
Click on the stakeholder you want to terminate. Click Actions (top right) --> Terminate Stakeholder
Pulley will send an email notification whenever the holder reaches a new vesting event.
